Q: What does Universal Serial Bus (USB) provide for mobile devices?
Option2: Standardized data and power connections

Q: Which connector is reversible and supports higher power/video alt-modes on many devices?
Option2: USB mini-B

Q: Which Apple mobile connector is proprietary and reversible?
Option2: USB-C

Q: What are serial interfaces used for on mobile equipment?
Option2: Legacy or specialty device communication (for example, RS-232 via adapters)

Q: What is Near-field communication (NFC)?
Option2: Very short-range radio enabling tap-to-pair, authentication, or payments

Q: What is Bluetooth typically used for on mobile devices?
Option2: Short-range wireless connection for accessories such as headsets, keyboards, and speakers

Q: What is a mobile hotspot?
Option2: A feature where a device shares its internet connection with others via Wi-Fi or tethering

Q: What is a touch pen (stylus)?
Option2: An input tool for precise taps/drawing; can be passive (capacitive) or active (with power/pressure sensing)

Q: What is the primary function of a headset?
Option2: Provide integrated audio input/output for calls and media

Q: What do external speakers add to a mobile setup?
Option2: Higher volume or fidelity compared with built-in speakers

Q: What is an external webcam used for?
Option2: Capturing higher-quality video or different positioning than the built-in camera

Q: What is a docking station?
Option1: A device that wirelessly charges phones only
Option2: A device that expands connectivity (power, video, networking, peripherals) often through a high-bandwidth connection for near-desktop experience

Q: What is a port replicator?
Option2: A simpler hub that provides additional ports (for example, USB, video) but usually less functionality than a full docking station

Q: How does a trackpad/drawing pad accessory differ from a mouse?
Option2: It provides touch or pen input with pressure/gesture features for precision drawing or navigation

Q: Which connection method is best for pairing wireless earbuds to a tablet?
Option2: Bluetooth
Option3: Near-field communication (NFC) alone for audio streaming

Q: A technician needs to connect many desktop peripherals and dual displays to a laptop with one plug. Best choice?
Option2: Docking station that supports power and multiple video outputs

Q: A field tech must transfer console logs from an old industrial controller with RS-232 to a laptop. Best method?
Option2: USB-to-serial adapter (serial interface)

Q: A user wants to share a phone’s cellular data with a laptop on the go without cables. Best feature?
Option2: Mobile hotspot (Wi-Fi tethering)

Q: Which statement compares docking stations and port replicators correctly?
Option2: Docking stations typically provide more power delivery and multiple video/network options; port replicators are simpler hubs
Option3: Port replicators always include dedicated GPUs

Q: Which connection is most appropriate for a modern Android phone to output video to a monitor (when supported)?
Option2: USB-C with DisplayPort Alternate Mode or a compatible dock
